from datetime import datetime, timedelta

start_date_str = "2025-09-17"
required_business_days = 26
holidays = {"2025-09-19", "2025-11-06", "2025-12-01", "2025-12-05"}

start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date()

# Alternative method: Generate all potential dates and filter to business days
all_dates = [start_date + timedelta(days=i) for i in range(100)]

# Filter to only business days (weekdays that are not holidays)
business_days = [
    d for d in all_dates
    if d.weekday() < 5 and d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") not in holidays
]

# Get the 26th business day (index 25, since we count from 0)
result_date = business_days[required_business_days - 1]

print(f"ANSWER: {result_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
